criteria.observation: Independent static audit and official Khronos validator: zero errors/warnings. Actual .blend loaded read-only in Blender 4.3.2. 8,293 authored/evaluated source vertices, 29,254 exported POSITION-stream vertices, 14,194 triangles, three primitives/materials, 790,652 bytes, no textures. Root identity and floor contact are correct. Reviewed source/export comparison and bound byte-identical rebuild.
Crown and branch joins work, but explicit no-long-acute-thorns obligation fails in 512px foliage closeups. Full-asset recognition does not override the closeup blocker.

Within the explicitly narrow evidence-informed concept scope, the dominant axis and subordinate laterals agree with PRI branching; flatter lateral branchlet distribution is a stated modern-analogue generalization. No identified fossil taxon, measured leaf scale or locality is claimed. Leaf grouping is artistic. This is not scientific reconstruction certification.

Source/generator/config hashes, exact budgets, 24 azimuth frames, all ten diagnostic views, native128 color/silhouette, 512 detail and claim labels are present and current. However, the explicit no-long-acute-thorns visual requirement is unmet. GPU and populated-scene gates remain unknown separately.
Pinned Three.js 0.180.0 GLTFLoader parsed exact standalone bytes; three mesh nodes, 14,194 triangles, 29,254 position-stream vertices and matching world bounds. No graphics context was created.
No exact-r11 target GPU/device evidence was supplied to this reviewer. Cloud Chromium socket launch was not attempted.
No exact-r11 intended scene GPU screenshots/measurements were supplied to this reviewer. Isolated counts do not establish 16/32-copy performance.

Native128 hero/cardinals and silhouette remain recognizable as an open conifer. All 24 azimuth frames retain dominant trunk, subordinate curved boughs, branchlet fingers, irregular windows and tapering leader. Front/rear tiers are orderly but not repeated cone hulls; intentionally open lower trunk stays quiet.

Middle-crown clay512 and underside show tapered round-section bough collars buried into the trunk, not plank cross sections. Neutral-gray bough-to-spray structure survives color removal. Closed component overlaps are intentional; no clearly floating spray was found in inspected views.

At128/whole512, the greater lateral foliage spread gives a coherent crown. At512 detail, triangular-section fingers still read as elongated pointed wedges/blades rather than resolved soft grouped shoots; tiny caps disappear. This is a closeup profile defect, not a denial of the whole-crown improvement.

Brief and metadata explicitly preserve modern-analogue limitation, artistic seven-meter scale and aggregated needle-bearing branchlet representation; no unchanged modern or identified extinct species is claimed.

defects.observation: Long narrow triangular wedge planes remain conspicuously acute in closeup. Nonzero terminal caps are mathematically present but visually insufficient.
defects.required_repair: Use a new revision. Shorten/soften the terminal transition and resolve cross-section/curvature at the 512px closeup so grouped shoots do not read as spear blades. Preserve present overall crown, gaps, curved boughs and rounded joins. Do not solve the defect by changing labels or dropping the closeup requirement.
defects.retest: New exact GLB/source hashes, neutral/color 512 details and underside/side evidence, native128 regression, complete full-angle set, technical and runtime gates. A new fresh reviewer is required for the new quality candidate.
